retrospectiveStatus: Exploratory: 2024/25 and 2025/26 were already inspected in v1; neither is a new confirmatory test
weightPolicy: Fixed before v2 evaluation; no search on 2025/26

features.quality: Attack and opposition defence xGOT/SOT relative to their competition; shrink to ratio 1
features.execution: Attack and opposition defence xGOT/xG relative to their competition; shrink to ratio 1

domesticPolicy: Only acquired provider leagues; normalize each observation against earlier same-competition data before combining with UCL. Missing countries remain uncovered.
prospectivePolicy: First valid capture per fixture is immutable; require not started and all history acquired by capture time. No backdating or automatic promotion.
